name: [X200 FREE AVA] Mount SKYTOPIA
desc:
Mount Skytopia - 30 Checkpoints Mountain Obby 🚩

🔥 FEATURES: 
🗡️ Weapon Throw & Teleport - Throw your weapon anywhere, then teleport straight to where it lands! Feel like the fastest ninja alive. 
🏆 Top 100 Summit Title Leaderboard & Badge 
🏞️ Stunning, breathtaking mountain scenery! 
🌅 Sky Changer - 15 options to choose from 


💡 Tip: Use your Weapon throw wisely! Throw your weapon onto hard-to-reach platforms to Shortcut checkpoints, then teleport to it. Master this skill to become the fastest
